# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It is the one rulebook shared by every AI platform working in this repo (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot). Copilot is not a judge lane: commit on a branch, run the affected test suites, and hand the work to Claude Code or Codex with a report. Copilot CLI sessions log to `skills/copilot-memory/memory.md`.
